title: Northgate Tire Center Claim Fitting Charge — Member Services Console Reference
content:
# Claim fitting charge on a Northgate Tire Center package

**What the rule settles.** The claim fitting charge is the installation package charge (`installation_package`) member services books on a Northgate Tire Center package for the one wheel whose tire was replaced under the treadwear mileage warranty. It is dated on the work order of the most recent treadwear claim entry recorded on the package and is booked against that claim entry.

**Observable effect.** Once booked, the package shows one installation package charge for that wheel, dated on the claim work order and linked to the treadwear claim entry; the package's balance of Tire Center charges rises by the amount. Nothing else on the package changes.

## The booking tool: `post_claim_fitting_charge_0bdb2547`

**Capability.** `post_claim_fitting_charge_0bdb2547` posts, on a Tire Center installation package, the charge for mounting, balancing and fitting the replacement tire on one wheel, dated on the claim's work order and linked to the treadwear claim entry the replacement came from. One call adds exactly one installation package charge entry for that wheel.

**How it is invoked.** This is a member services tool held on the agent side. It is first unlocked with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then called with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, under the name `post_claim_fitting_charge_0bdb2547`.

**Parameters.**

- `tire_service_id` — the installation package reference number of the tire set, as read from the Tire Center package lookup.
- `tire_position` — the wheel concerned, exactly one of:
  - `left_front` — the driver-side front wheel;
  - `right_front` — the passenger-side front wheel;
  - `left_rear` — the driver-side rear wheel;
  - `right_rear` — the passenger-side rear wheel;
  - `spare` — the full-size spare;
  - `all_positions` — one entry covering every wheel of the set at once.
  For this charge it names the wheel the replacement tire was fitted on.
- `service_date` — the date of the claim work order the fitting belongs to, written YYYY-MM-DD as on that work order entry, with no time and no time zone.
- `odometer_miles` — the vehicle odometer on that claim work order, a whole number of miles with no separators or decimals.
- `source_event_id` — the reference number of the treadwear claim entry the replacement tire came from, as read from the package's Tire Center work history.
- `amount` — the fitting charge to book, in USD with 2 decimal places, zero or more; the value is passed already worked out to the cent and is booked as given.

| Parameter | Format |
|---|---|
| `tire_service_id` | package reference number (text) |
| `tire_position` | one of the six wheel values above |
| `service_date` | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `odometer_miles` | whole miles |
| `source_event_id` | treadwear claim entry reference number (text) |
| `amount` | USD, 2 decimal places, zero or more |

**Return.** A receipt rendered as text with: `tire_event_id`, the reference number of the new charge entry; `tire_service_id`, the package charged; `charge_component`, always `installation_package`; `tire_position`, the wheel charged; `service_date`, the work order date (YYYY-MM-DD); `amount`, the charge booked in USD with 2 decimal places; and `status`, "booked" when the entry was added. A receipt with status "booked" means the charge now stands on the package.
